The Far-Eastern Republican Party () was a political party based in Vladivostok that advocated for the restoration of the Far Eastern Republic.
History
The party was formed on the basis of the Vladivostok branch of the Russian People's Front (RPF) at the Founding Congress on July 13, 1990, in Vladivostok by the secretary of the RPF Igor Cherevkov, at the time the deputy of the Vladivostok City Council.
In 1992, DVRP demanded a referendum on the restoration of the Far-Eastern Republic, threatening to form a provisional government and speak at the UN and The Hague.
In 2009, during the Vladivostok rally against the anti-crisis policy of the Russian authorities, Igor Cherevkov demanded the change of the entire elite of power both in Moscow and in Primorye.
